days.label: Fly NYC to Dublin
days.summary: JetBlue B6 841 departing JFK at 9:04 PM. Arrive Dublin 9:00 AM Wednesday.

days.label: Arrive & Explore Dublin
days.summary: Land 9:00 AM. Taxi/Aircoach to hotel. Easy walk through St Stephen's Green and Georgian streets. Jet-lag recovery day.

days.label: Dublin: History & Culture
days.summary: Trinity College, Book of Kells, Chester Beatty Library, optional Guinness Storehouse.

days.label: Dublin: Howth Coastal Day Trip
days.summary: DART train to Howth, cliff walk loop, seafood lunch, optional distillery tour.

days.label: Train to Galway
days.summary: Morning train Dublin → Galway (~2.5 hrs). Walk the Latin Quarter, Spanish Arch, live music at night.

days.label: Cliffs of Moher & Burren
days.summary: Full-day guided tour to the Cliffs of Moher and the Burren limestone landscape.

days.label: Galway → Shannon → Edinburgh
days.summary: Relaxed morning in Galway — last walk, breakfast, pack up. Afternoon bus to Shannon Airport (Bus Eireann, ~1h 45m, depart ~1:30pm). Ryanair FR1676 departs 4:00pm, arrive Edinburgh ~5:15pm. Taxi to city centre by ~6pm. Check into hotel, evening stroll on the Royal Mile.

days.label: Edinburgh: Castle & City
days.summary: Edinburgh Castle, walk the Royal Mile, St Giles' Cathedral, National Museum or Arthur's Seat.

days.label: Edinburgh: Explore & Distilleries
days.summary: Flexible day — Palestine Museum, Holyrood Distillery, Dean Village walk, Calton Hill at sunset. Or just wander and soak up the city at your own pace.

days.label: Scottish Highlands Day 1
days.summary: Check out of Edinburgh hotel (ask them to store main luggage). 2-day small-group tour departs ~8:45am. Cairngorms National Park, Loch Morlich, Inverness. Overnight in a Highland B&B (included in tour price). Bring just an overnight bag.

days.label: Highlands Day 2 & Final Evening
days.summary: Tour continues: Loch Ness, Glencoe, Great Glen, return to Edinburgh ~7pm. Check back into hotel, collect stored luggage. Last dinner in Scotland. Fly home tomorrow (JetBlue B6 72 at 12:10 PM from EDI).
